title: Childhood horn picture and stage acting
summary: A childhood picture with an old horn, the nickname 1776, and his acting in local stage plays such as Dark Tower.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: That's a nice old style horn.
That's a nice old voice. Well the guys had a nickname for me, 1776. 1776. In response to this horn.

Are there any particular questions that you would like to ask me concerning any of the music career or pictures I'd be happy to show them to you? This one here Paul, I'm also somewhat of an actor on the stage. I played in about five or six major productions, that is locally. Was offered a part in Deep of the Roots on Broadway but didn't accept it. This picture here is Dark Tower. A very, very fine play directed here by Mrs. Myra Hemings. I had the leading role in that also.
